distribution.summary: Sichuan; Fujian; Hainan; Guangxi; Yunnan; Xizang; Taiwan; Chongqing
distribution.narrative: Huang & Lu (2015) reports Sichuan, Fujian, Hainan, Guangxi, Yunnan and Xizang under the historical species usage Dryocoetiops coffeae. Beaver & Liu (2010) separately reports Taiwan under the same historical usage. Beaver et al. (2019), using the current accepted name Dryocoetiops moestus, independently reports Sichuan, Yunnan and Taiwan, supporting a subset of the already reviewed distribution rather than replacing the earlier records. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Chongqing as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Huang & Lu (2015), under the name Dryocoetiops coffeae, lists the nine existing plant taxa from Phoebe sp. through Mangifera indica. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes broad host use and Coffea spp. as a secondary-pest association; the latter genus-level entry is retained separately from the species-level Coffea arabica record. Beaver et al. (2019) provides no additional named host in the integrated Source Record. Historical names are not silently substituted for the currently accepted beetle name.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetiops moestus (Blandford, 1894).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetiops moestus (Blandford, 1894), VSN_2454, Scolytinae: Dryocoetini. 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) use the source name Dryocoetiops coffeae; current synthesis follows integrated taxonomic backbone while retaining the older name at source layer.
